recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中脂肪空泡之間有三系造血，含大量核圓而深染的紅血球前驅細胞、散在的骨髓系細胞與偶見的巨核細胞，細胞量大致正常，未見明顯異常浸潤，單看 H&E 形態缺乏特異性。
features: Bone marrow core with roughly 40–50% cellularity interspersed with adipocytes
Trilineage hematopoiesis with maturing erythroid, granulocytic and megakaryocytic elements
Numerous erythroid precursors with small round dark nuclei, some in clusters
Scattered megakaryocytes with normal-appearing lobulated nuclei
Interstitial red cells; no abnormal infiltrate, fibrosis or granulomas in this field
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy (H&E, 40x) shows marrow with approximately 40–50% cellularity and trilineage hematopoiesis among adipocytes. Erythroid precursors with small, round, hyperchromatic nuclei are readily identified, together with maturing granulocytic cells and scattered morphologically unremarkable megakaryocytes. No abnormal infiltrate, fibrosis or granulomas are seen in this field. The H&E morphology is nonspecific, and evaluation of erythroid precursors requires immunohistochemistry (glycophorin A, spectrin) and clinical correlation with the red cell disorder under investigation.

ddx.vs: Morphologically similar; any erythroid membrane or hemoglobin defect is not detectable on H&E and requires ancillary studies.
Shows a clearly increased erythroid-to-myeloid ratio with erythroid colonies dominating the marrow.
Shows prominent binucleated and multinucleated erythroid precursors, better seen on aspirate smears.
Small lymphocytes with dark nuclei can mimic erythroid precursors but form aggregates and are CD20 or CD3 positive, glycophorin A negative.
